TRIGGER_PATTERN: Sector ETF prediction where the prior session had a >+1% relative FTS day (XLP 3d rel +1.30% paid on 09-01), the current morning has flat futures (ES +0.13% / NQ +0.16%), and the model treats the follow-through as already-paid and scores S4=0 with flat/flat — but the actual session delivers XLP −0.32% vs SPY +1.05% (rel −1.36%) because the model applied the follow-through rule asymmetrically: it used the prior FTS day to cap magnitude at flat but did not consider that a flat-futures morning after an outsized relative day can reverse hard when the broad market rips on a macro catalyst (ISM Services beat) that the model explicitly identified as two-sided and refused to pre-score.
CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: When a sector had a >+1% relative FTS day 1–2 sessions prior and the current morning shows flat futures with no fresh sector catalyst, the model scores S4=0 (follow-through already paid), S0=0 (two-sided macro not pre-scored), and predicts flat/flat — treating the prior FTS as confirmation of a completed move rather than as a potential exhaustion event that sets up mean-reversion when the macro tape flips risk-on.
CORRECTED_BEHAVIOR: When a sector had a >+1% relative FTS day 1–2 sessions prior and the current morning shows flat futures with a same-day two-sided macro catalyst (ISM Services, claims) that could flip the tape risk-on, the model must treat the prior FTS as a two-sided object: it caps upside magnitude (no second FTS up-day) AND it licenses downside risk if the macro catalyst resolves risk-on (which unwinds the defensive bid). Specifically: (a) if the two-sided catalyst is high-impact and the sector's 1d relative is already negative (XLP 1d rel −0.12%), score S4 as −0.5 to −1 rather than 0, because the FTS bid is the marginal positioning that gets sold when SPY rips; (b) do not let "two-sided" mean "zero" when the sector's recent relative outperformance creates asymmetric downside to a risk-on resolution; (c) the follow-through rule must be symmetric — it caps magnitude in both directions (no second FTS up, but also no protection from FTS unwind).
